title: Common contract definitions
description: Shared primitives for ExtractionResult and PrivateTariff. Enums mirror the app.* Postgres types in docs/specs/2026-11-10-data-model-v1.3.md section 6 so generated types line up with the database.

DecimalString.description: Decimal quantity or amount as a string. JSON floats are forbidden anywhere near money or cargo quantities; consumers parse into shopspring/decimal (Go) or Decimal (Python).

Locode.description: UN/LOCODE: two-letter ISO country code plus three-alphanumeric location code, e.g. BRSSZ, DEHAM. Existence in the reference dataset is checked by core-api, not by this pattern alone.

Iso4217Currency.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 currency code. Membership in the organization allow-list is checked by core-api.

FreightModal.description: Mirrors app.freight_modal. v1.3 prices FCL and AIR only; LCL is still extracted and flagged out-of-scope by core-api.

Incoterm.description: Incoterms 2020. FAS, FOB, CFR and CIF are sea/inland-waterway terms; pairing them with modal AIR is a deterministic-check failure (RFC-004 section 4).

EquipmentOrUnit.description: Equipment for FCL (dry/reefer/open-top/flat-rack/tank in 20/40/45 ft) or a handling unit for AIR and LCL. Business-reviewable list; extend here only, never in generated code.

EvidenceSource.description: Where an extracted value came from: the email body or a named attachment (e.g. ATTACHMENT:booking.pdf). Drives split-screen UI highlights.

ReasonCode.description: Machine-checkable codes only, never prose. core-api appends codes from its deterministic checks (RFC-004 section 4); ai-engine may prefill INFERRED_VALUE, AMBIGUOUS_NUMBER, AUDITOR_UNREACHABLE or MODEL_ESCALATED.

FieldStatus.description: Computed by core-api from deterministic checks plus auditor confidence (RFC-004 section 5). Never set by ai-engine; present so the same envelope shape can be persisted and rendered by web.

FieldValue.description: Per-field extraction envelope (RFC-004 section 3). Every extracted value travels in this shape.

value.description: The normalized value as a string. Enums, LOCODEs and dates keep their documented formats; money and quantities are DecimalString.

exact_quote.description: Literal excerpt of the source supporting the value. core-api re-finds it in the original text (NFKC, collapsed whitespace, case-folded); offsets are computed by core-api, not the model.

inferred.description: True when the value was deduced rather than stated. Inferred fields can never be GREEN.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability from the confidence auditor (pplx-decider-v1.2), not the extractor's self-report. Stored as NUMERIC(5,4).

reasons.description: Reason codes accumulated through the pipeline; ai-engine writes its own, core-api appends check results.

Embedding.description: qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b vector at 1024 dimensions (MRL), L2-normalized. One vector space across the platform.
